title: New Moon in Aquarius
tldr: A seed point for future vision, community, individuation, innovation, and the courage to belong without disappearing.
theme: Aquarius is a fixed air sign ruled traditionally by Saturn. This New Moon begins work around future vision, community, individuation, innovation, and the courage to belong without disappearing.
shadow: detachment disguised as enlightenment, rebellion without responsibility, or selling a version of yourself you do not believe in
integration: changing the system without abandoning your own aliveness

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc asks whether you can serve the collective without erasing your own spark.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Aquarius; watch what the Leo Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Saturn kamea, black tourmaline, salt, elm, feather, candle, and water.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Aquarius. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through future vision, community, individuation, innovation, and the courage to belong without disappearing, without repeating the shadow of detachment disguised as enlightenment, rebellion without responsibility, or selling a version of yourself you do not believe in?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Aquarius intention take form?
